tags: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
description:
Shipwell is a freight trucking startup that provides businesses with an automated way to transport goods and services. The company believes that all businesses can have best-in-class shipping and transportation networks to ensure the efficient movement of goods and services. It builds intelligent and connected tools and software that allow shippers, brokers, and carriers to communicate in real-time and move freight in a painless and delightful way. It then leverages advanced analytics to uncover opportunities in their supply chain networks and help drive impact.

It also combines a marketplace for shippers to connect with freight companies and online tools to manage those shipments. The company makes money by charging a commission on freight services and fees for its freight management software platform.

Shipwell was founded in 2016 and is based in Austin, Texas.

name: SOLARCYCLE
description: Solarcycle is a solar technology company that builds a circular economy for solar and renewables. The company offers an affordable and eco-friendly service for recycling and reusing decommissioned solar panels and technologies, catering to solar asset owners. Leveraging its patented technology, it can retrieve up to 95% of precious metals such as silver, silicon, copper, and aluminum from solar panels, as well as repurpose or recycle panels that are currently in use.

name: Sundae
description: Sundae provides a residential real estate marketplace intended to help sellers get a fair price for their house. It offers an alternative to the unpredictability of the traditional real estate agent sales process. Users can sell as-is on their timeline. That means they do no clean-up, repairs, showings, or any work at all. It is the only marketplace connecting home sellers with a large network of local investors, ensuring that homeowners get the highest possible off-market price for their homes.

name: Terabase Energy
description:
Terabase Energy is a digital solutions company whose products and services reduce costs and accelerate deployment in large-scale solar.

The company's proprietary software is used by more than 400 Engineering, Procurement, and Construction firms, developers, and independent power producers in 28 countries.

name: Turntide Technologies
description:
Turntide specializes in developing sustainable technologies that drive down energy consumption and operating costs in buildings, agriculture, and electric transport, boosting bottom lines and accelerating a global path to 100% renewable energy. It has developed an efficient electric motor system, based on revolutionary switched reluctance technology, managed by advanced cloud software. Its goal is to eliminate the 25% of global electricity consumption that is wasted by legacy electric motors, thus accelerating the world’s transition from fossil fuels and leaving them in the ground where they belong.

The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.

name: Wheelhouse
description:
Wheelhouse is a business intelligence platform that helps turn the hosts and owners into superheroes. We're proud that thousands of hosts and owners have used our flagship product, data-driven pricing, to earn significantly more revenue from their business.

We're a team of YC alums, data science PhDs, hedge fund engineers, product evangelists, and hustlers.

Our team's core values are "empowered together" and "seriously fun." We think that captures the mood and values of a team that works exceptionally well together, pushes the envelope, and is not against cracking a beer together around 5 PM on Friday.

name: airSlate
description: AirSlate is a global SaaS technology company that provides no-code business process automation and document management solutions. The company's PDF editing, e-signature workflow, and business process automation solutions empower users to digitally transform their businesses to run faster and easier. AirSlate, pdfFiller, signNow, and USLegal make up the company's portfolio of award-winning products.

name: Apiiro
description:
Apiiro enables security and development teams to proactively remediate risk before releasing to the cloud. Apiiro develops the industry's first Code Risk Platform™ to aid application and infrastructure stakeholders to accelerate delivery by automatically reducing product risk with every material change before it is shipped to production.

Apiiro empowers security and development teams with complete visibility and actionable context, so they can proactively fix risks across the software supply chain.

name: Autoscience Institute
description: Autoscience merges science and tech to automate vehicles, improving safety, efficiency, and performance. It integrates AI, robotics, and materials science to transform transportation.

name: Awardco
description: Awardco is a human resources technology company that specializes in employee recognition and rewards solutions. Its platform enables organizations to build culture, incentivize performance, and drive modern engagement strategies by providing customizable recognition programs integrated with major online retailers like Amazon and Lazada. Awardco's platform is utilized by over 3,000 organizations across 163 countries, serving more than six million users. The company's services are designed to reduce employee turnover and absenteeism by fostering a culture of appreciation and engagement.

name: Beacon Biosignals
description: Beacon Biosignals is a neurotechnology company focused on bringing precision neuroscience into clinical trials and treatments for brain- and sleep-related disorders. The company’s core offering includes an FDA-cleared wearable device (the Waveband headband) that captures high-fidelity EEG during sleep and wake states, combined with an AI-driven analytics platform that processes millions of hours of neural data to extract biomarkers of brain function. Its end-to-end solution supports pharmaceutical and biotech clients by providing tools for patient stratification, dose-response monitoring, and early-stage disease progression, enabling trials to be more precise and efficient.

name: Blank Street
description: Blank Street is a coffee chain that offers coffee as a daily ritual that more people can enjoy, in places convenient to their lives. Its automated espresso machines consistently produce consistent coffee, allowing baristas to be more interactive and build relationships. Customers can order ahead of time using their app, streamlining their experience. Their vendors (outsourced milk and pastries) are excellent, allowing them to concentrate on the coffee.

name: Bloomscape
description: Bloomscape is an online plant shopping platform that offers home-ready plants and tools for plant care. The company makes buying plants easy by delivering ready-to-go plants to its customers' doors. It is a DTC company with a mission to drastically improve the entire plant buying and care experience in every area of the home and garden.

name: Castelion
description:
Castelion is a venture-backed defense tech company applying modern hardware development and manufacturing processes to critical national security challenges, specifically to solve affordability, scale, and supply chain robustness. The company combines vertical integration, rapid iteration, and high-cadence testing to build hardware that is engineered from the ground up for scalable production.

Castelion’s core offerings include solid-rocket motors, missile avionics, flight-control systems, seekers, and full strike-weapon assemblies, all designed for compatibility with existing military launch platforms.

name: ChannelEngine
description:
With a single powerful Software as a Service integration, ChannelEngine connects a seller's systems to international marketplaces and sales channels while optimizing sales, minimizing time, and maximizing profit and reach. It offers brands, distributors, and retailers automated order and return systems, an advanced management suite, and a rich partner ecosystem to bring their sales to the next level.

ChannelEngine empowers companies by creating a seamless integration between businesses and marketplaces. Learn more: www.channelengine.com.

name: Chariot Defense
description: Chariot Defense is developing the sophisticated hardware and software framework to address the military's most pressing problem: the distribution, control, and transformation of energy into power on the contemporary battlefield.

name: Claros
description: Claros is a power management technology company that develops hardware and software solutions for data center power delivery and AI computing infrastructure. The company develops Integrated Voltage Regulators (IVRs) that deliver power closer to AI processors to reduce energy loss and improve compute efficiency. It also develops Power Gateway, an 800 VDC intelligent power distribution platform designed to reduce power conversion losses and coordinate energy from utilities, generators, renewable sources, and energy storage systems. Claros focuses on improving power efficiency, compute density, reliability, and infrastructure costs for data centers and AI workloads.

name: Doccla
description:
Doccla is the virtual ward company. We are the pioneers of tech-agnostic virtual wards. We partner with care organizations to enable early discharge and prevent hospital readmission by monitoring patients remotely using best of breed devices.

Doccla’s COVID-19 support service evolved from a research project we were running for the NHS and was designed collaboratively with Northampton General Hospital, where the service is now in live use.

name: DOSS.COM
description: Doss provides an adaptive resource platform (ARP) that integrates core business functions such as inventory management, procurement, sales orders and billing, accounting, warehousing, and production planning into a unified system. The platform includes a workflow editor, allowing users to automate processes and configure workflows tailored to their operations. Doss also offers DataStudio, a feature that enables users to create dashboards and monitor sales analytics, production metrics, and operational KPIs without the need for separate business intelligence tools. The system supports integration with digital tools, facilitating the aggregation of orders across point-of-sale systems and synchronization of data from third-party sources and warehouses. Doss serves various industries, including Industrials, Consumer Goods, Food and Beverage, Construction, Distribution, and Cosmetics, providing a centralized solution for managing complex operations.

name: Dryft
description: Dryft is a software company that specializes in Artificial Intelligence in optimizing manufacturing operations.

name: Dwelly
description: Dwelly is a property technology company that acquires and partners with independent residential lettings agencies. The company provides AI-powered software and operational tools to support property management, tenant services, compliance, payments, maintenance, and agency operations. In addition to acquiring agencies, Dwelly integrates technology and operational support to help modernize property management while maintaining existing agency brands and client relationships.

name: Emidat
description: Emidat builds climate intelligence for the construction industry.

name: Empathy
description:
Empathy is a leading technology company transforming the way people plan for and navigate life’s toughest moments. By combining cutting-edge innovation with compassion, Empathy provides unparalleled support for bereavement, estate management, legacy planning, and more. 
Trusted by Fortune 500 companies and leading life insurers, Empathy serves over 40 million individuals across North America, setting a new standard for modern family care and workplace benefits.
Empathy’s mission is to make care as practical as it is compassionate—partnering with employers, insurers, and financial institutions to deliver scalable support that eases emotional burdens, simplifies complex logistics, and empowers families to move forward with clarity and resilience.

name: Faro Health
description: Clinical protocols are scientific decisions wrapped in administrative burden. The Faro system handles the tedious work better left for a computer, freeing clinical researchers to focus on the important decisions that drive clinical value.

name: Fay Nutrition
description: Fay Nutrition connects individuals with dietitians and nutritionists who accept insurance, making professional dietary support more accessible. The company focuses on providing affordable nutritional services and shares insights on lifestyle changes related to nutrition through their social media platforms.

name: Feedvisor
description:
Feedvisor is the pioneer of Algo-Commerce – the discipline of using Big Data and Machine Learning Algorithms to make business-critical decisions for online retailers. 

Feedvisor’s cloud-based Algorithmic Repricing and Revenue Intelligence solutions power millions of pricing decisions daily, providing retailers with actionable insights to maximize profitability and drive their business growth. 

Feedvisor was founded in 2011 and has since become a true market leader. In the last year alone, Feedvisor’s customer base has grown by 250% and over $1 billion in GMV is managed on the Feedvisor platform. Clients have seen results of up to 500% increase in sales and 40% increase in profit margins. 

Feedvisor’s technology has won several prestigious industry awards, including the Red Herring Top 100 Global in 2014 and Frost and Sullivan’s Technology Leadership Award 2014. 

Visit us at www.feedvisor.com.

name: Flashfood
description: Flashfood is the app for grocery's best deals. As a certified B-Corp, our mission is to feed families, not landfills. Our marketplace connects food retailers in North America who have products that are near-expiry or surplus that may have been destined for waste, and offers it instead to motivated consumers who want to save serious cash. B2B2C has saved consumers over $250B USD and redirected over 150M pounds of food from waste streams.

name: Fourier
description: Fourier is developing a modular and fully automated hydrogen production system, designed to be deployed where and when it is needed the most. This eliminates the need for hydrogen transportation. The company aims to make on-site hydrogen universally accessible, contributing to a sustainable energy future. Their innovative architecture is a key element in this mission.

name: Hippocractic AI
description: Hippocratic AI presents a platform that develops safety-focused large language models tailored for healthcare settings. The company offers AI agents designed to engage in non-diagnostic, patient-facing tasks such as preoperative preparation, post-discharge follow-up, and chronic-care management. Its architecture is built on a multi-agent system that aims to reduce clinician burden by managing routine patient interactions, while a clinician-driven test framework ensures service readiness. The service includes an “agent store” where licensed clinicians can design and deploy new agents across diverse specialties, and health systems, payers, or providers can deploy them to support outreach and engagement workflows.

name: JADU
description:
Jadu AR Inc. is an augmented reality company building immersive mobile games powered by custom technology that brings high-fidelity spatial gameplay to mobile devices.

The studio has released two titles: Jadu: Fight in AR, a real-time PvP game, and PANIC AR, a story-driven wave shooter. PANIC, currently in development, features hundreds of concurrently simulated enemies, 3D projectiles, and advanced post-processing effects. The result is a level of immersion not previously possible on mobile.

Jadu’s generative authoring and scene understanding tools enable character-driven scenarios that stay responsive to player actions and physical context. Both games have received strong player enthusiasm, with a 4.9-star average rating across 400,000 installs.

Founded in 2019, Jadu began with a fascination for how virtual characters interacting with physical spaces could shape culture. The company rose to prominence when its AR-enabled Web3 assets saw over $30 million in secondary trading. Over the years, the team has collaborated with cultural icons including Elton John, GRIMES, Lewis Hamilton, Lil Nas X, Michael Bay, Serena Williams, and Snoop Dogg.

Jadu has raised $42 million from investors including Bain Capital, General Catalyst, LG Tech Ventures, and Com2Us.

name: Kopperfield
description: Kopperfield develops a platform to facilitate home electrification easily. Mark Wong and Jesse Vaughan founded Kopperfield.

name: Lila Sciences
description: Lila Sciences is a platform that uses artificial intelligence to support research in life sciences, chemical sciences, and materials sciences. It develops AI-driven tools and autonomous labs to improve research efficiency and facilitate scientific discoveries. The platform is designed to enhance various aspects of the scientific method and contribute to advancements in technology and innovation.

name: Luma AI
description: Luma AI develops tools that let users generate photorealistic images and videos from text, image, or video prompts via its Dream Machine platform. Its models learn from multimodal data, including video, audio, and language to build “world models” that can reason about motion, context, and physics. It provides access through a web app, iOS app, and API, enabling creative professionals to scale visuals for storytelling, advertising, animation, gaming, and more. For enterprises, Luma offers a secure full-stack solution with data ownership, legal clarity, and customizable AI models.

name: MD Ally
description: MD Ally develops a telehealth emergency care platform to offer ease of access between public safety practitioners and providers. The company integrates telemedicine into the EMD process to triage callers, non-life-threatening concerns, virtual medical and behavioral healthcare professionals, in-network follow-up care, alternate transportation, and social services.

name: Meter
description: Meter provides Internet infrastructure for businesses, handling everything needed to get great Internet, networking, Wi-Fi, and cell coverage in a space. Their unified stack—enterprise hardware, software, and operations—is purpose-built, scalable, and delivered as a service for one predictable monthly fee. Today, some of the largest companies and enduring institutions rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive. Meter is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by leading venture capital firms, investors, and founders.

name: MinIO
description: MinIO is a provider of High Performance Enterprise Object Storage solution released under a proprietary license. It is API compatible with Amazon S3 cloud storage service and designed for production enterprise environments. Use MinIO AIStor to build high performance infrastructure for machine learning, analytics, and application data workloads with enterprise-grade features, support, and compliance.

name: Native Security
description: Native Security is a cloud security control plane for enterprises. It translates security outcomes into native cloud controls, simulates deployment impacts, and maintains alignment as environments change. The platform enforces security at the architectural level across multi-cloud setups.

name: Onebrief
description: Onebrief is a software platform that supports operational planning, real-time collaboration, and decision workflows for military staffs and command teams. It provides a unified workspace where live, synchronized data, agent-based workflows, and collaborative editing help users build plans, maps, briefs, orders, and other operational products more efficiently than traditional manual processes. The platform integrates structured information across tools and networks to keep all contributors aligned and updated instantly. Onebrief also offers APIs to connect external systems and automate routine tasks, enabling smoother coordination and information sharing across complex operations. The environment is engineered to maintain continuity under varied conditions and support iterative planning and experimentation within command structures.

name: OneSchema
description: OneSchema provides AI agents for data operations that automate data prep, driving efficiency and improving client project margins. By standardizing raw client files to your RFIs, OneSchema helps teams reach insights and deliver results faster.

name: Orchard Robotics
description: Orchard Robotics develops an operating system that enables precision agriculture driven by robots and AI. Its camera systems and computer vision software gather precise data for the visible fruit on any tree. It is utilized by growers, packers, and marketers to manage crop load and supply chains.

name: Payrails
description: Payrails helps businesses transform payments and other connected financial workflows from an operational bottleneck into a competitive edge. From Payment Orchestration to Unified Analytics, Tokenization, Automated Reconciliation, Chargeback Management, and more, Payrails helps category-defining merchants to get more from their financial infrastructure. With a modular, provider-agnostic approach that allows teams to integrate our products at any scale and combination, our track record has made Payrails a trusted partner for some of the world’s most recognized names including Puma, Vinted, Flix, Careem, InDrive, and many more.

name: PhysicsX
description: PhysicsX is a physical AI company on a mission to accelerate innovation and overhaul what engineering and manufacturing look like today. The company is building a new software stack to deliver deep AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. PhysicsX partners with leading organizations in Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, Semiconductors, Materials, and Energy, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London and New York.

name: Primus
description: Primus helps elderly people slow the aging process by eliminating loneliness and achieving 'Zero Falls'. We ensure that we are proactive rather than reactive by conducting a series of examinations prior to onboarding elders so that they can be monitored by our in-house medical staff under a personalized care plan.

name: Pronto
description: Pronto is an on-demand home services platform that connects users with professionals for household tasks such as cleaning, laundry, mopping, dusting, window and bathroom cleaning, and other domestic help. It provides a digital interface where customers can select the type of service they need, schedule instant, scheduled, or recurring assistance, and arrange payment through the platform. The service matches verified service providers to requests and facilitates the booking process from selection to completion. Pronto’s platform organizes domestic work and aims to streamline how household services are booked and delivered.

name: Prosimo.io
description: Prosimo delivers a simplified multi-cloud infrastructure for distributed enterprise cloud journeys. Their services include this stack, which combines cloud networking, performance, security, observability, and cost management.

name: Prypco
description: PRYPCO is a real estate technology company. It operates a digital platform that combines multiple services related to real estate, including property buying and selling, mortgage assistance, fractional property investment, and related administrative services such as residency and Golden Visa support.

name: Raphe mPhibr
description: Raphe mPhibr is an aviation and aerospace component manufacturer that designs and manufactures comprehensive solutions.

name: Remesh
description: Remesh offers an AI-powered platform that enables users to have live conversations with their customers at scale and organize audience responses in real-time. It helps users to understand their customers or employees and make more informed business decisions by empowering them to engage with up to 1,000 people at once online and in real-time.

name: Render
description: Render helps software teams like Base44 and OpenAI ship products fast and at any scale. We host everything from hundred-line prototypes to AI agents and applications with hundreds of services, all with a relentless commitment to reliability and uptime.

name: Sleeper
description: Sleeper is a sports platform intended for fantasy leagues and eSports. The platform connects fans and people to create a community and friendship that enable users to enjoy a sporting event in a communal way that creates lasting memories.

name: Slide
description: Slide provides a business continuity and disaster recovery platform for Managed Service Providers.

name: Snackpass
description:
Snackpass is a social food app that makes ordering food more convenient, affordable, and social. It focuses on mobile order pickup at local restaurants. The platform allows users to unlock discounts with friends, send gifts, and collect points.

Snackpass was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Spiral
description: Spiral is building multimodal warehousing that works with the tools you love.

name: Standard Bots
description: Standard Bots develops industrial robotics systems that combine robotic hardware with AI-driven software to automate manufacturing and operational tasks. Its product portfolio includes collaborative robotic arms with different payload capacities, as well as software platforms that support robot programming, fleet management, and application development. The company’s technology enables users to teach robots through demonstration rather than relying solely on traditional coding methods, allowing robots to perform tasks such as machine tending, inspection, palletizing, welding, and material handling. Standard Bots also provides AI capabilities that allow robots to learn from observed actions, adapt to changes in their environment, and improve task execution over time. In addition to its robotic systems, the company offers operating software, development tools, and integration capabilities designed to support deployment across a range of industrial workflows.

name: Substrate
description: Substrate builds a semiconductor foundry to revitalize semiconductor production capabilities. The company utilizes advanced X-ray lithography, which uses light billions of times brighter than the Sun to improve chip manufacturing efficiency.

name: Teambridge
description: Teambridge is the only AI-native contingent workforce management platform that is purpose-built for the complexities of managing hourly, contract, and frontline teams. Teambridge helps businesses drive revenue, reduce costs, and retain talent. The fully composable, no-code platform unifies recruiting, onboarding, credentialing, scheduling, time tracking, and compliance into an end-to-end system, replacing manual processes with automations while giving you the flexibility to run your business your way. With a powerful, user-friendly app for everything from shift swaps to time tracking and earned wage access, Teambridge drives worker engagement and retention.

name: Vannevar Labs
description:
Vannevar Labs is a group of technologists and former defense and intelligence officers building computer vision and natural language processing products for some of the country’s most important national security problems. The company believes its military service members and intelligence officers deserve access to the best technology American innovation can offer and is building great products for this mission.

Vannevar Labs was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

name: Veho
description: Veho provides technology-enabled parcel delivery and logistics services for eCommerce brands. The company operates a network of warehouses and delivery partners to support last-mile shipping, including next-day and two-day delivery, while providing brands and customers with delivery tracking, flexible delivery options, and customer support.

name: Vital Lyfe
description:
Vital Lyfe is a Climatech product manufacturer that develops systems to produce safe drinking water from a range of natural sources, including seawater, without reliance on centralized infrastructure. The company designs portable water-making hardware that combines filtration, purification, and engineering principles adapted from aerospace to enable autonomous operation in diverse environments. Its offerings aim to serve use cases where traditional water infrastructure is limited or unavailable, such as humanitarian relief, maritime operations, disaster response, and off-grid communities.

Vital Lyfe provides hardware platforms alongside supporting software for monitoring and management of water quality and system performance. The company engages with partners in sectors like non-governmental organizations, maritime organizations, and outdoor or expedition users to deploy and validate its solutions. It continues to refine and scale its technologies toward broader market availability and expanded field applications.

name: 100ms
description: 100ms is a live-video infrastructure platform that provides subscription-based products to its customers. The company provides a low-code solution for companies looking to add video/audio conferencing within their own applications. The increasingly virtual, remote-first world needs an infrastructure provider that allows these experiences to happen seamlessly. 100ms' best-in-class quality and ease of use are fueling this revolution. Making live video work - our team has been obsessed with this problem for years and solved it at world-class scales for different network and device conditions. A great infrastructure provider also needs to have the shortest integration time - so our foundation is built on the above two principles.

name: Agave
description: Agave provides a unified API for accessing data across all construction software systems, such as Procore, BIM 360, QuickBooks Online, and others. Agave's software combines project management, financial, and bidding platform tools, allowing developers to access all available data.

name: Airmeet
description: Airmeet serves as an all-in-one virtual events platform for event organizers, marketers, community builders, and enterprises. With a core focus on creating the immersive and integrated virtual events platform for knowledge professionals, Airmeet’s scalable platform supports a variety of event formats including fairs, expos, meetups, workshops, summits, town halls, and more, virtually.

name: Anyfin
description:
We want to help as many as possible to the best possible financial situation. Using new technology, we develop fair, simple, and smart services that help you get more from your finances. So that you can do more of what makes you feel good.

We saw that many paid unnecessarily high interest and fees for part-payments, credit cards, and private loans. So that’s where we started out. Through smart technology and skipping unnecessary middlemen, we could offer the lowest possible rate. And we decided straight away: we would always try to help you improve your finances. Never give an offer if we can’t improve your situation. Only make things better.

You could say we started out by helping you deal with your financial past. That was in 2018. In 2020, we launched more services, for instance, helping you keep track of subscriptions and plan your finances. Ways to simplify your financial everyday life. So that we can help you build your financial future. And we’re just getting started.

Anyfin is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

name: Axio Biosolutions
description: Axio is a MedTech R&D and Manufacturing Company focused on Advanced Surgical and Wound Care. Axio has the distinction of being the first company from India to get USFDA clearance for a Wound Care/Hemostat product. Controlling life-threatening bleeding continues to be the major cause of death from traumatic injuries. Axiostat is its flagship product developed to reduce mortality due to traumatic bleeding. A CE approved product, Axiostat is based on a patented novel 100% chitosan platform and has variants catering to Emergency & Trauma, Military, Cardiovascular, and Dental applications.

name: Bevy
description:
Bevy is an enterprise-grade virtual conference and community events SaaS platform. It incorporates a variety of tools to plan, promote, and execute virtual conferences and community events. The platform is a flexible software solution that can be used to manage and host thousands of different types of virtual events. Built with enterprise-level analytics, integrations, and data security, the Bevy platform is used by a range of enterprise, consumer, and education teams who want to host virtual events and turn them into thriving global communities. Featuring a deep permissions system and webcasting capabilities, community and field marketing teams can empower local brand advocates all over the world to build small local communities that collectively provide reach and scale.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

name: BlackPoint
description: Blackpoint Cyber is a technology that offers a nation-state-grade cybersecurity ecosystem. Blackpoint Cyber serves the MSP community using its own proprietary security operations and incident response platform, SNAP-Defence, available as a product or as a 24/7 true managed detection and response (MDR) service.

name: Brick&Bolt
description: Brick&Bolt is an e-commerce marketplace providing end-to-end construction services with absolute trust and transparency. We ensure money safety through our escrow facility, transparency using technology, quality through our in-house project management team, and on-time delivery through penalty clauses for any delays. If you are looking for any building or house construction, Brick&Bolt is the place to go!

name: BrowserStack
description: BrowserStack is a software testing platform that runs more than two million tests per day across 15 global data centers. It enables Microsoft, Twitter, Barclays, Expedia, and more than 25,000 customers to produce high-quality software quickly by transferring testing to the cloud. Its technology delivers rapid access to over 2,000 real mobile devices and browsers via a highly reliable cloud architecture that scales seamlessly as testing requirements grow. BrowserStack enables development and QA teams to move quickly while providing an exceptional client experience.

name: BRYTER
description:
BRYTER is a no-code software platform that automates and helps its users to develop and build digital applications. It helps consulting firms, banks, corporates, and public administration across the globe to digitize and scale their services.

BRYTER operates offices in Berlin, Frankfurt, and London. The software supports professionals at Baker McKenzie, Hogan Lovells, Taylor Wessing, Simmons & Simmons, ING, Telefónica, and other companies around the globe.

It was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.

name: Campfire
description:
Campfire is the AI-native ERP for high-growth companies. We give modern, mid-market, and enterprise accounting teams superpowers by automating the work that nobody wants to do: manual transaction categorization, bank reconciliation, revenue recognition, and variance analysis. Our customers close 5x faster and save up to hundreds of thousands annually. We're privileged to work with some of the fastest growing AI companies in the world, including Replit, Decagon, and PostHog, as well as service providers, health tech, and aerospace companies. 

Accounting Intelligence automates the manual work that buries your team. Our proprietary AI model was trained specifically on accounting data, auto categorizing transactions, matching payments to invoices, and reconciling bank accounts automatically. You review and approve instead of doing everything from scratch. 

Ember AI is your built-in analyst. Ask questions in plain language and get answers with source data in 30 seconds. Ember drafts flux variance commentary, analyzes spending anomalies, and builds custom reports on demand. 

Revenue Automation handles complex billing recognition for modern SaaS companies. Subscription, usage-based, tiered, platform fees, and contract modifications: automated schedules and ASC 606 compliance out of the box. 

Core Accounting delivers multi-entity consolidation, continuous close, and real-time financial statements without downloading to spreadsheets or managing separate instances per entity. 

Custom Reporting lets you build reports in seconds with drill-down to any transaction. Executive dashboards update continuously, replacing month-old spreadsheets with real-time visibility. 

Campfire is SOC 1 and 2 certified with granular permissioning and full audit trails, supporting companies from Series B through IPO. Campfire simplifies audit-ready processes with locked periods, contract databases, and comprehensive audit trails. By combining scalable architecture with an API-first design, it enables finance teams to close faster, elevate reporting, and support global operations with visibility and efficiency.

name: CHECK24
description: CHECK24 is a platform that provides free comparisons across insurance, energy, finance, telecommunications, and travel sectors. It enables users to find favorable tariffs and prices by creating transparency in the market. The service aims to simplify decision-making for customers through easy-to-use comparison tools.

name: Cinder
description: From content moderation to responsible AI, Cinder empowers businesses to orchestrate and automate digital safety at scale. Cinder was founded to help organizations foster safe online spaces for everyone. The Cinder platform empowers companies from start-ups to enterprises with end-to-end capabilities to mitigate harm, investigate abuse, and produce trustworthy and reliable AI outcomes. Building your world-class company means keeping your users and community safe—Cinder unlocks faster growth by making safety easy. We work with customers in every industry from frontier AI labs to e-commerce and social media.

name: Code Metal
description: Code Metal is an AI software company that provides a platform for automated code translation and verification, converting high-level code into production-ready formats for deployment across varied hardware targets. Its technology combines machine reasoning with formal analysis to produce verified and compliant software, supporting code modernization, portability, and adaptation to different languages and systems. The platform is applied in contexts where stringent correctness and safety checks are essential, helping technical teams move research or legacy code toward reliable operational use. Code Metal also integrates testing and traceability into its workflows to support rigorous software validation during automated transformations.

name: Cogsy
description: Cogsy helps DTC brands eliminate manual spreadsheets and guesswork to automatically order the right inventory at optimal levels and grow in the best way possible.

name: commercetools
description:
Over the last decade, businesses have struggled to adjust digital commerce experiences at the same pace as consumer behavior, preferences, and the rapidly diversifying touchpoints that have emerged (e.g., web, smartphone, tablet, POS). This constant state of change required the technical agility to quickly test and co-opt new trends and technologies to meet true omnichannel demands.
